sections.heading: History Tab
sections.content:
The History tab shows a list of all images generated during a session. By right-clicking on any image in the list, you can view it at full resolution in an external window, or restore the settings required to generate the same image again, etc.

tyDiffusionhistory does not persist between 3ds Max sessions. If you close 3ds Max, thetyDiffusionhistory will be cleared.
